findings.problem: BENCH_DEV_MODE_ID macro is set to 1 in code
findings.evidence: #define BENCH_DEV_MODE_ID 1 forces MY_TANK_ID to 1, bypassing DIP switches and Flash overrides
findings.root_cause: Bench development flag was not cleared to 0 prior to commit
findings.potential_impact: All STM32 boards deployed in field will boot as Tank ID 1, causing immediate bus collision and collapse of multi-drop addressing
findings.reproduction_scenario: Connect 2 STM32 slave boards to shared UART bus. Both will transmit STAT,1 telemetry
findings.verification_method: Verify DIP switch reading correctly reflects on bus telemetry after setting to 0

findings.problem: Incoming UART commands dropped when line_ready flag is set
findings.evidence: Single rx_line buffer drops incoming bytes if main loop hasn't processed previous line yet
findings.root_cause: Lack of circular FIFO queue for incoming UART messages
findings.potential_impact: Rapidly sent commands from ESP32 master can be silently dropped
findings.reproduction_scenario: Send 3 commands from ESP32 within 5ms interval; observe dropped commands
findings.recommended_fix: Implement a ring buffer (FIFO) for UART RX lines
findings.verification_method: Verify burst transmission of 5 commands in HIL test

findings.problem: Blocking delay calls in HMI command handlers
findings.evidence: delay(400) and delay(600) used for UI button color toggle animation
findings.root_cause: Blocking delay used for visual feedback timing
findings.potential_impact: Blocks main loop for up to 600ms, delaying UART telemetry processing and watchdog handling
findings.reproduction_scenario: Press SAVE button on HMI and measure main loop latency
findings.recommended_fix: Replace delay() with a non-blocking millis() timer state machine
findings.verification_method: Verify main loop execution time stays under 1ms during save operation

findings.problem: Uncalibrated software NOP loop for microsecond timing
findings.evidence: for (volatile uint32_t i = 0U; i < count; i++) __asm__ volatile("");
findings.root_cause: Using CPU loop multiplication rather than hardware timer or DWT cycle counter
findings.potential_impact: Delay durations vary with compiler optimization flags (-O0 vs -O3), risking missed wiper steps on digital pot
findings.reproduction_scenario: Compile with -O3 and measure INC pin pulse widths on oscilloscope
findings.recommended_fix: Use DWT->CYCCNT for microsecond delay timing
findings.verification_method: Measure pulse width on oscilloscope across optimization levels

findings.problem: Lack of digital filtering on raw ADC temperature samples
findings.evidence: Raw single ADC sample converted directly to temperature without moving average or median filter
findings.potential_impact: Electrical noise from triac or power supplies can cause temperature spikes and spurious fault trips
findings.reproduction_scenario: Inject noise into ADC input and observe current_temp_c fluctuations
findings.verification_method: Verify stable temperature readings under noisy conditions

findings.problem: Missing CRC or Checksum in ASCII UART protocol
findings.evidence: Commands and telemetry frames lack checksum byte
findings.root_cause: Protocol designed as plain text ASCII for simplicity
findings.potential_impact: Line noise corrupted bytes could be parsed as valid erroneous commands
findings.reproduction_scenario: Inject bit errors into UART line and check if bad commands execute
findings.recommended_fix: Append 2-character Hex XOR checksum to frames

findings.problem: Array bounds check tightness on max_goz_sayisi
findings.root_cause: Boundary check logic sensitive to array index offsets
findings.potential_impact: Risk of out of bounds access if MAX_GOZ definitions mismatch
findings.recommended_fix: Harmonize boundary checks with explicit array range macros
findings.verification_method: Verify maximum tank limit handling in service menu

findings.problem: Blocking ADC polling call in superloop
findings.root_cause: Polled ADC design instead of interrupt or DMA driven
findings.potential_impact: Adds unnecessary microseconds delay to main loop iteration
findings.recommended_fix: Convert ADC reading to interrupt driven or timer triggered

findings.problem: Unused legacy MikroBasic file present in workspace

findings.evidence: No MX_IWDG_Init or HAL_IWDG_Refresh calls in project
findings.root_cause: Hardware watchdog not configured in CubeMX
findings.potential_impact: System cannot self-recover if MCU locks up due to heavy ESD
findings.verification_method: Simulate software deadlock and verify automatic MCU reset
